title: PSA: If you’re in the US, do not subscribe to Sight & Sound print

commenti.body: I pre ordered their top100 films issue and it took I believe 4 or 5 months after the magazine hit shelf’s before it actually came to my house and ya emailing them is a crap shoot. It took 2 weeks to get a response and it basically said if it don’t show up in another 4 weeks contact us again and we will look into the issue.

I just subscribed last month so this is a bit of unfortunate timing for me lol. 

I’m very glad you posted this though, because at least now I know to make sure I get my complaints into them in time to actually get my issues when they inevitably don’t show up!

I’m not too pressed because I’ve been reading the digital back-issues anyways, but at least I’ll know to not get a print subscription in the future…

Yeah, I’ve also been checking out the digital back issues. Such a treasure trove, though a bit clunkily designed haha. Though I find outdated websites more charming than issues never arriving!

Hope you have better luck with the print issues than many of us have!
That magazine is published by the British Film Institute.  Call them (remember the time difference) about their lousy subscription service (which is probably handled by an independent company).
Yeah, I did email BFI to no avail but a phone call might be worth a shot. Thanks for the suggestion.

For what it’s worth, my December issue just showed in the mail today shockingly! 

It was bearing a return address to Sweden, is that what the postage always says?

HA mine did as well! Just arrived today, also with a Swedish return address. 

It’s the first issue of my subscription that has arrived, so I don’t know if that postage is typical or not. 

Thanks for the update, and I hope you are enjoying the issue!
